name: Seraphine Delaunay
source:
A member of Unit Prime, Verre is perhaps the least conspicuous presence in the group, yet also one of its most decisive. Her scionic ability allows her to influence emotions and memories through eye contact or voice, intervening quietly in situations that would otherwise spiral out of control. This very power has made her private life difficult: those who grow close to her inevitably begin to question the sincerity of what they feel.
